findings.finding: Bank OZK's $915M construction loan to IQHQ on the vacant 1.7M SF RaDD life-science campus in San Diego was rated PASS at Q2 (Gleason on the July 21 call: 'if our thoughts in that regard change, we'll make appropriate adjustments'). The Q3 release is the first document that must show how the loan was graded at 9/30. A downgrade to substandard or nonaccrual would roughly triple nonperforming loans (Q2 NPLs ~$300M) and could bring a specific reserve against a $461.5M allowance. findings.finding: At the Wells Fargo healthcare conference on 2026-09-10, management said Q3 2026 adjusted EPS was 'tracking ahead of prior expectations' on favorable benefit expense. It also said Medicare Advantage was ahead of expectations, the Medicaid BER and margin were tracking slightly ahead of the full-year outlook (-1.75% margin) on July rate actions, and individual ACA was modestly better on slower bronze cost emergence. The 'prior expectation' was the Q2-call guide of Q3 at about 17% of $27, roughly $4.59. Consensus is $4.66-4.70 and the whisper $4.95, so the street has moved only partway to a beat. My read is about $4.95, +6% vs consensus.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: ELV has beaten consensus in each of the last four quarters. The reactions were mixed: Q2 2026 beat ($7.45 vs $6.18) with a raise to >=$27 went -8.54% (sold on the quality of the beat, a $0.80 below-the-line gain and operating margin down to 3.6%); Q1 2026 beat ($12.58 vs $11.03) with a raise went +0.03%; Q4 2025 went +5.86%; Q3 2025 went -1.22%. Beats on this name are not reliably paid.

findings.finding: UnitedHealth reported Q3 2026 on 2026-10-13, after ELV last spoke. Its MCR was 88.4% vs 89.9% a year earlier and vs about 89.9% expected, and adjusted EPS was $4.69 vs $4.12-4.15 consensus. It raised FY adj EPS to at least $20.50 from $19.50-20.00. The MCR includes $610M of favorable 2026 reserve development, and Medicaid membership fell 85k on eligibility changes. For the industry, Q3 cost trend did not deteriorate.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No ELV-specific history on peer read-throughs found. On ELV's own Q2 print, peers moved in sympathy (CNC -4.9%, HUM -1.7%), so the group trades together on cost-trend news.

findings.finding: Rates and builder sentiment worsened through MHO's Q3 (Jul-Sep) and into October. Freddie Mac's 30-year rate was 6.66% at end-August, 6.95% in late September and 7.40% in early October. The NAHB index went 35 (Aug) -> 32 (Sep) -> 29 (Oct, the lowest since June 2012), and the share of builders cutting prices went 35% -> 38% -> 43%. MHO's call commentary on October traffic and on buydown costs will reflect this.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: MHO gives no numeric guidance, so its outlook is call commentary. On the Q3 2025 print, with orders down 6%, the stock fell 6.14%. On the Q2 2026 print, management cited choppy demand and rising rates and the stock still rose 1.54%.

findings.finding: Both peers that reported after MHO's July 29 call guided cautiously and traded down. Lennar (Jun-Aug quarter, reported 2026-09-16): orders -9% to 20,879, below its own range; full-year deliveries cut to 80-81k from 82-83k; shares down about 4.6%. KB Home (2026-09-22): orders -12%, pace 3.1 vs 3.8 per community, Q4 housing gross margin guided 16-16.6% against 17.2% consensus; shares fell about 2% after hours despite an EPS beat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Peer prints show beats being sold on margin outlook this cycle (KBH beat, fell; LEN missed, fell). MHO's own mixed prints: -6.14% (Q3 2025, orders down), +1.54% (Q2 2026, orders +15%).

findings.finding: MHO's own Q2 10-Q shows rising pressure on Q3 margins. Incentives were $63.2M in Q2 against $47.1M a year earlier, with mortgage-rate buydowns up $22.0M. Homebuilding gross margin was 19.7% against 22.6%, and company gross margin 22.1%. There were 2,839 unsold homes under construction, more than the 2,426-unit backlog, plus $4.2M of inventory charges and $4.0M of Florida warranty charges. Management wrote that 'market conditions may persist through the remainder of 2026'. With rates about 30-50bp higher during Q3, clearing those specs costs more. Yet consensus of $3.25 implies EPS up from Q2 adjusted $3.14.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025: gross margin was 23.9% of revenue with $7.6M of inventory charges; the stock fell 6.14%. Q2 2026: margin 22.1% (down 260bp) on a record-orders quarter; the stock rose 1.54%.

findings.finding: The Q3 order comparison is easy and community count is growing. Q3 2025 new contracts were 1,908 (-6%) on 234 average communities, about 2.7 per community per month. Q2 2026 set a record 2,387 (+15%) at 3.4 per month with cancellations at 8%. Management expects 2026 average community count about +5% with more openings in the second half. Even with a seasonal pace drop to about 2.8 per month on about 240 communities, Q3 orders would print about 2,000, up about 5% year on year, against peers at -9% to -12%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Orders are the line MHO trades on. Q3 2025 orders -6%: stock -6.14%. Q2 2026 orders +15% record: stock +1.54% (damped). Q1 2026: +3.69%.

findings.finding: On 2026-08-12 the board approved a new $250M repurchase authorization, replacing the prior one, which had $120.3M left at June 30; the stock rose 5.1% on the news. The run-rate had been $50M a quarter. With the stock now at $123, about 0.96x June 30 book of $127.88, Q3 and Q4 repurchases are accretive to book and a call statement on pace can support the shares.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The announcement itself moved the stock +5.1% (Aug 12-13). Buybacks ($50M a quarter) have accompanied mixed print reactions.

findings.finding: Revenue bar risk from backlog conversion. Consensus revenue of $1.11B implies about 2,340 deliveries at about $460K plus about $33M of financial services, which is about 96% of the 2,426-unit June backlog. Conversion was 89% in Q3 2025 (2,296 of 2,577), 98% in Q2 2026 and about 106% in Q1 2026. A Q3-2025-like conversion gives about 2,160 deliveries and about $1.03B of revenue.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: deliveries -6% and revenue -9%, yet the stock rose 1.54% on orders. Deliveries are secondary to orders for this name.
